opportunities.title: Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)
opportunities.description: Official KAUST admissions materials describe VSRP as a fully funded research internship for 3rd- and 4th-year bachelor's and master's students in STEM. Internships last 2 to 6 months, with flexible start and end dates throughout the year, and more than 100 faculty-led projects. Official benefits include a USD $1000 monthly stipend, private bedroom/bathroom, airfare to KAUST and back, social and cultural activities, and access to core laboratories.
opportunities.eligibility: Official entry requirements: undergraduate students in 3rd year or above and master's students; minimum GPA 3.5 on a 4-point scale (or equivalent); evidence of English proficiency as listed on the internships page. Current PhD candidates, KAUST students or KAUST alumni are not eligible. Graduates are eligible if the degree will have been completed within one year of the internship start date. Required documents include official transcripts in English, one faculty recommendation letter, a valid passport with at least 6 months validity, a statement of purpose, and a CV.

opportunities.title: KAUST Ph.D. Program (Spring 2027 admission)
opportunities.description: Official KAUST admissions materials describe the Ph.D. as an intensive research program typically completed over eight semesters and four summer sessions. Official Fees & Funding materials state that all admitted PhD students receive the fully funded KAUST Fellowship covering tuition and bench fees, a monthly stipend worth USD $25,000 to $30,000 per year depending on qualifications and academic progress, base accommodation, health insurance, and relocation support. Official timeline for 2026-2027: Spring 2027 admission is only open to PhD applicants; Round 1 application deadline 27 September 2026; Round 1 decisions 8 November 2026; spring semester starts 17 January 2027. Some students with external sponsorship may not be eligible for the Fellowship.
opportunities.eligibility: Official materials direct applicants to KAUST entry requirements. Spring 2027 admission is only open to PhD applicants. Degree-program pages may require additional coursework or an assessment exam.

opportunities.title: KAUST M.S., M.S./Ph.D. and Ph.D. Programs (Fall 2027 admission)
opportunities.description: Official KAUST admissions timeline states that Fall 2027 admission is open to MS, MS/PhD and PhD applicants. Round 2 application opens 28 September 2026, deadline 3 January 2027, decisions 14 February 2027, fall semester starts 29 August 2027. Official Fees & Funding materials state that admitted MS and PhD students receive the KAUST Fellowship, including full tuition and bench fee coverage, a monthly stipend worth USD $20,000 per year for M.S. students and USD $25,000 to $30,000 for Ph.D. students, base accommodation, health insurance, and relocation support.
opportunities.eligibility: Official materials direct applicants to KAUST entry requirements. Fall 2027 is open to MS, MS/PhD and PhD applicants.
